{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows with negative customer_age to compute valid mean
df_valid = df[df['customer_age'] >= 0]
mean_age = df_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Confirm the number of valid records
valid_count = len(df_valid)
invalid_count = len(df) - valid_count

mean_age, valid_count, invalid_count"}
